meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为你的项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文件:根目录一份,复杂度达标的子目录各一份,内容是该目录的结构、命令、约定和禁用写法。
howto.when: 当一个仓库需要把结构、命令和约定写下来给 agent 用时触发;也可以直接输入 /init-deep 开始。

say.text: /init-deep 给这个仓库生成 AGENTS.md 知识库
say.note: 先读已有文件,再补写或新建
先读旧文件,全部删除后重建

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates a layered AGENTS.md set for your project: one at the root plus one per subdirectory that meets the complexity score, each covering that directory's structure, commands, conventions and forbidden patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents; you can also run /init-deep directly.

say_en.text: /init-deep generate an AGENTS.md knowledge base for this repo
say_en.note: reads existing files first, then updates and adds
reads existing files, removes all, rebuilds
